summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund I filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit facility. The registrant's subsidiary, GPIF I Funding, entered into a second amended side letter with Bank of America as administrative agent, modifying the minimum utilization level used to calculate the unused commitment fee through September 30, 2026. No new equity, acquisition, divestiture, or structural change is involved. This is a routine financing covenant adjustment, not a special situation.
